noBase: Both sides created this file. Without a common ancestor, every difference counts as a conflict.
mixedEol: The sides use different line endings ({{ours}}: {{oursEol}}, {{theirs}}: {{theirsEol}}). They are ignored when comparing; the result keeps {{eol}}.
splitter: Split between the sides and the result

rebaseOurs.hint: The state your commits are placed onto.

rebaseTheirs.hint: The commit that is being replayed right now.

cherryPick.hint: The change from the picked commit.

revert.hint: The state without the reverted commit.

header.encoding: Detected encoding of the file – kept when saving

error.goneTitle: This file is no longer in conflict
error.goneBody: <path>{{path}}</path> is already resolved – maybe in the terminal, in another program or via the context menu. The operation continues.
error.title: The conflict file could not be loaded

resolve.remainingNext_one: {{count}} conflict file still open – continuing with “{{next}}”.
resolve.remainingNext_other: {{count}} conflict files still open – continuing with “{{next}}”.
resolve.allDoneMerge: All conflicts resolved. Finish the merge in the commit panel.
resolve.allDoneContinue: All conflicts resolved. Continue the {{operation}} in the commit panel.

large.title: Very large file
large.text: With {{lines}} lines, the file is too large to compare both sides line by line. Take one side completely – or compare anyway; that can take a moment.

deletedByUs.title: Deleted on one side, changed on the other
deletedByUs.text: The file no longer exists in “{{ours}}”; “{{theirs}}” changed it. Should it stay?

deletedByThem.title: Changed on one side, deleted on the other
deletedByThem.text: “{{ours}}” changed the file; it no longer exists in “{{theirs}}”. Should it stay?

bothDeleted.title: Deleted on both sides
bothDeleted.text: The file no longer exists under this name on either side – usually because both renamed it. The new names appear as separate entries in the list of conflicts.

addedOneSide.title: Only present on one side
addedOneSide.text: This name only exists in “{{side}}” – usually because both sides renamed the same file differently. Should the file stay under this name?

binary.title: Binary file
binary.modifiedBinary: Both sides changed the file. Binary content cannot be merged line by line – take one of the two versions completely.
binary.modifiedNoText: Both sides changed the file. The content cannot be read as text – take one of the two versions completely.
binary.addedBinary: Both sides created the file. Binary content cannot be merged line by line – take one of the two versions completely.
binary.addedNoText: Both sides created the file. The content cannot be read as text – take one of the two versions completely.

takeAll.title: {{all}} – overwrite edited blocks?
takeAll.body_one: {{count}} conflict block was edited by hand. This text will be replaced by the version “{{side}}”.
takeAll.body_other: {{count}} conflict blocks were edited by hand. This text will be replaced by the version “{{side}}”.

reset.title: Reset the solution for “{{name}}”?
reset.body: All decisions and everything typed by hand will be lost. The file will then be back to how it was at the start.

save.blockedOpen_one: {{count}} conflict still open. Saving is possible once there are no conflict markers in the result.
save.blockedOpen_other: {{count}} conflicts still open. Saving is possible once there are no conflict markers in the result.
save.blockedMarker: There is still a conflict marker in the result (line {{line}}). Saving is possible once it is gone.
save.readyNone: Nothing left to decide – the result can be saved.
save.ready: All conflicts resolved – the result can be saved.
save.tip: Writes the result to the file and stages it
save.label: Resolved – save and stage

takeWorktree.title: Take the file as it is?
takeWorktree.body: Your decisions here in the tool will be lost. The file is saved as it currently is in the working directory.

leave.title: Leave “{{name}}” without saving?
leave.body: The solution is not saved yet. Until then, the file stays in conflict.
leave.keepBody: Selection and text are kept as long as the app is running.
leave.discardBody: All decisions for this file will be lost.

handEdited.clean: The file in the working directory was edited elsewhere and no longer contains conflict markers. Take it as it is – or resolve here; saving then replaces it with the result below.
handEdited.dirty: The file in the working directory differs from this comparison – it was probably already edited by hand. Saving replaces it with the result below.

result.title: Result
result.subtitle: editable – this is how the file will be saved
result.manualTip: The text differs from the selection above
result.eolTip: Line endings of the file – kept when saving
result.noFinalNewlineTip: The file ends without a newline – this stays the same when saving

block.bothSame: Changed the same way on both sides – taken
block.otherChanged: Unchanged – the other side changed here
block.title: Conflict {{number}}

intent.toggleTip: Show or hide the column that explains what both sides wanted
intent.title: Intent
intent.intro: Explains for every conflict what each side wanted – from the commit messages, pull requests and the block texts – and proposes a text that keeps both. Nothing is sent before you click.
intent.proposal: Proposed text compared with the current text
intent.diffLabel: Proposed text for conflict {{number}}: added lines marked with plus, removed lines with minus
intent.same: The proposal is the current text of this block.
intent.applied: Applied – the block now counts as edited by hand. Undo works in the result as for typing; save as usual when you are done.
intent.shortened: Explained only – the block is too large to propose a text for it.
intent.redacted: Explained only – the block contains values that were masked before sending.
intent.leftOut: Not explained – left out to stay within the size limit.
